title: For SME customers, identify the month in 2013 with the highest total consum
question: For SME customers, identify the month in 2013 with the highest total consumption. Then, compute how much more that peak-month consumption was compared to the consumption of customer ID 7 in the same month.

prediction.sql:
WITH peak_month AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) AS month_id,
        SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS total_sme_consumption
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013' 
      AND T1."XCL_002" = 'SME'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_7_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS cust_7_consumption
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_001" = 7
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) = (SELECT month_id FROM peak_month)
)
SELECT 
    pm.total_sme_consumption - c7.cust_7_consumption AS difference
FROM peak_month pm
CROSS JOIN customer_7_consumption c7

WITH peak_month AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) AS month_id,
        SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS total_sme_consumption
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013' 
      AND T1."XCL_002" = 'SME'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_7_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS cust_7_consumption
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_001" = 7
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) = (SELECT month_id FROM peak_month)
)
SELECT 
    pm.total_sme_consumption - c7.cust_7_consumption AS difference
FROM peak_month pm
CROSS JOIN customer_7_consumption c7

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH peak_month AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) AS month_id,
        SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS total_sme_consumption
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013' 
      AND T1."XCL_002" = 'SME'
    GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2)
    ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_7_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(T2."XCL_021") AS cust_7_consumption
    FROM customers AS T1
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019"
    WHERE T1."XCL_001" = 7
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) = '2013'
      AND SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 5, 2) = (SELECT month_id FROM peak_month)
)
SELECT 
    pm.total_sme_consumption - c7.cust_7_consumption AS difference
FROM peak_month pm
CROSS JOIN customer_7_consumption c7

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH sme_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.XCL_020 AS month,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON ym.XCL_019 = t.XCL_010
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'SME'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2013'
    GROUP BY ym.XCL_020
),
peak_month AS (
    SELECT month, total_consumption
    FROM sme_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer7_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        ym.XCL_020 AS month,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON ym.XCL_019 = t.XCL_010
    WHERE t.XCL_013 = 7
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) = '2013'
      AND ym.XCL_020 = (SELECT month FROM peak_month)
    GROUP BY ym.XCL_020
)
SELECT 
    pm.month,
    pm.total_consumption - COALESCE(c7.total_consumption, 0) AS difference
FROM peak_month pm
LEFT JOIN customer7_consumption c7 ON pm.month = c7.month
